strings.subtitle: — Momtoowo fiilde —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Doodgol e accugol ngol alaa. Huutoro butoŋ les ɗoo.
strings.ssd_warning:
Reental! E SSD laawol winnditgol ɓooyngol hoolaaki momtugol sabu TRIM.
Ndeen jaɓɓorgo ko fii HDD.
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• Ɗemɗe keɓeɗe NTFS (ADS) ngollaaka.
• Deftere USN ndeynkaaka.
• Natuuji ɗiɗi e jokkondiral duule
  (OneDrive ekn.) ɓe memaaka.
strings.status_full: Loowdi ndin winnditaama fow e ɓolɗe. Ndeentaake — kuutorɗe ɗe kolloy ɓolɗe tan.
strings.status_fast: Hoore, joofgol e njaaje 4 MB winnditaama. Ko heddii meemaaka, kono sabu wostooje, ndeentagol timmungol kuutorɗe sadar ɗe waawaa. Fii ɗeri suuɗiiɗi huutoro noone TIMMUƊO.
strings.status_empty: Fiilde nden meere wonunoo, winnditgol waɗaaka. Momtaama.
strings.error_permission: Waawaa heɓde fiilde nden. Ina waawi udditaade e jaɓɓorgo goɗngo. Uddu nden etto kadi.
strings.error_not_found: Fiilde heɓaaka. Ina waawi wonde nden momtaama tawo.
strings.error_is_symlink: Ndee ko jokkorde maandeeji. Jokkorde ɗe mbaawa momteede — fiilde fii ndee heddoto e jam.
strings.error_reparse: Ndee fiilde nokku (OneDrive walla nanndunde). Keɓe mayre ina e duule, wonaa e diski — ɗoo alaa ko momtee.
strings.error_not_file: Ndee wonaa fiilde (foldar walla goɗɗum). Acc fiilde.
strings.error_hardlinks: Ndee fiilde ina jogii jokkorɗe tiiɗɗe goɗɗe ({n} fow). Jokkorɗe tiiɗɗe ndokkaaka hoore — inɗe fow nanndi. So a momtii e laawol jooni, keɓe ɗen winnditete e tagga haa 32 bayt, kono ko heddii heɓoyte e jokkorɗe goɗɗe. Momtu fow jokkorɗe ado.
strings.error_compressed:
Fiilde nden ɓoodnaama, suuɗnaama walla seeɗa. Winnditgol e ɓolɗe hoolaaki momtugol keɓe ɓooyɗe sabu NTFS noofi ɗe no goɗngol.

Ittu sifaa: Ñebbo ñaamo → Sifaaji → Yeeso → ittu maande "Ɓoodnu" e/walla "Suuɗ". Caggal ɗuum, huutoro SHREDDER kadi.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Fayliji {count} maa momtu.
Ɓetton: {size}.

Ƴeew doggol ngol hade maa jokkude.
Ngal golle ruttaaka.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Ittu fayliji {count} ɗii fof e doggol?

Fayliji ɗii ɗiin rayɓataa — ko doggol ngol tan.
strings.hardlink_text:
Fayliji "{name}" ina jogii jokkondire tiiɗɗe goɗɗe ({nlink} fof).

Geɗe ɗee momtoto ɗee inɗe fof.
Kono kuutorɗe (32 bytes) heddoto e inɗe goɗɗe e nder folda on.

Ina gasa tawa ko faatii momtude ɗeen kuutorɗe.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Naatnu e jokkondire tiiɗɗe fof e doggol ngol
